Your mental health matters as much as your lungs. Quitting supports both when paired with care.
Speak to yourself the way you would speak to a friend who is trying this hard.
You deserve comfort that does not cost your health. Build a list of comforts that are truly kind.

Schedule joy on purpose: music, nature, a show, a bath. Joy makes cravings smaller.

You are worth the time it takes to learn healthier coping skills one day at a time.

Practice saying no to people and situations that push you toward smoking. That is self respect.
Your wellbeing includes saying I need a break before I need a cigarette.

Your nervous system is recalibrating. Be patient like you would with a healing injury.

Spend time with people who make you feel safe, not judged. Safety supports quitting.
